android.desc:
Reminders is your simple, all-in-one todo list, task manager, and notes app designed to boost your productivity and keep you organized. Easily manage tasks, set reminders, take notes, and view everything in a calendar—all in one place.

✅ Stay on top of your schedule with ease:
✔ Todo Lists & Tasks – Organize tasks efficiently.
✔ Reminders & Alarms – Get notified so you never forget anything.
✔ Notes & Quick Memos – Jot down important thoughts instantly.
✔ Calendar Integration – See all tasks & deadlines at a glance.
✔ Customizable Widgets – Access your todo list, calendar, or notes from your home screen.

📅 All-in-One Productivity & Reminder App
Reminders combines your calendar, tasks, todo lists, and alarms into a simple, yet powerful app. We prioritize ease of use—no clutter, just a clean and efficient way to manage your tasks.

Whether you're planning your day, tracking habits, or setting priorities, Reminders helps you stay on track and reduce stress.

🔑 Key Features to Boost Productivity:
📆 Calendar View – See your daily schedule at a glance.
📌 Widgets – Add tasks, calendar, or notes directly to your home screen.
⭐ Task Filters – View tasks for today, starred items, or full schedule.
🔔 Smart Notifications & Alerts – Set personalized reminders & alarms.
🎯 Goal Tracking & Habit Builder – Stay focused and achieve more.

🔒 Private & Secure: No Ads, No Tracking
Your data is 100% private—no ads, no tracking, and full encryption for your todo lists, notes, and calendar.

🌟 Unlock Premium Features:
🚀 Web Access – Manage your tasks, notes & calendar from any device.
☁ Cloud Backup – Keep your todo lists safe & recoverable anytime.
🔄 Device Sync – Access your reminders & notes across all devices.
📂 Advanced Filters – Create custom todo list views for a personalized workflow.

From todo lists to scheduling, calendar planning, and setting reminders with alarms, Reminders is the ultimate productivity app to keep you focused and organized.

📲 Download Reminders now and start achieving your goals today!

quotes.text:
My daily driver! Considering how much time I spend with these tools, it's surprising that I had relatively few iterations over the years.

I have two major use cases:

1) a TODO list

2) longer texts (project plans, travel plans, shopping lists for things to buy sometimes in the next 6 months (e.g. books to read), etc.).

The TODO list is my daily driver. As the family became larger, it became difficult to track what needs to be done the next day (including simple things, like "give a daily dose of vitamin", "clean & lube the bike chain every 2w"). For a very long time, I used pen & paper. It was OK, used it for years, but it didn't scale so well with kids. An Android TODO/reminder app with notifications and repeats was a life saver. I used BZ Reminder (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bzzzapp) which ticked all the boxes. But the author decided to downgrade the lifetime licences to periodic... It's still not expensive but I don't approve the behavior. After trying out a dozen of similar apps, I ended up with "Reminders: Todo List & Notes" (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pocketbrilliance.reminders). I can't live without a tool like this anymore. TBH, pen & paper TODO lists are still around.

For the longer texts I used an offline wiki (ZIM) for quite some time. Then gradually moved to Google Keep (simple, can accept text & lists, and can be shared). The Keep collection kept growing. With both lists and texts. It's pretty bad input method, …
quotes.story_title: My productivity app is a never-ending .txt file (2020)
